methods.label: Two points determine a line
methods.explanation: The two nails correspond to two points. Since the line through two points is unique, the wooden strip is fixed in place. The other examples are applications of “the line segment between two points is the shortest path” and “the perpendicular segment is the shortest.”
methods.levelReason: Uses only Grade 7 facts about line uniqueness, shortest paths and perpendicular distance.
